We have template 1914398: seems to replace a bromine on aromatic nitro compound with something else? Retro: product is nitro aromatic with Br substituent? Actually retro: product is nitro aromatic with Br attached? Wait retro: product side is [#7;+:2]-[c:3]... with Br substituent on aromatic (c with Br). The forward reaction: Br-Br? Actually the retro splits into Br-Br (bromine) and the nitro aromatic with Br? Hmm.

Our previous step gave nitro bromide: O=[N+]([O-])c1cc(Br)c2c(c1)CCC1(CCC1)O2

Now applying template 1914398 to that should give a phenol (replace Br with OH?) The retro template shows Br-[Br] (bromine) plus the nitro aromatic with Br? Wait the product side includes Br substituent on aromatic (c with Br). The retro splits that into Br-Br (bromine) and the same aromatic? Actually the retro seems to remove a bromine from aromatic, generating bromine as a separate molecule and leaving the aromatic unchanged? Let's apply to our brominated nitro compound.


<thought>Apply template 1914398 to the brominated nitro aryl fragment to generate its de-brominated version.</thought>
